models.X1: Stacked J1 + M, same frozen weights (availability-informed; live headline)
models.X: Stacked: per-market linear pool of J0 and M (weights fixed on validation)
models.J0: Joint simulation, participation from history only (cutoff-faithful)
models.A: Baseline A: recency-weighted game log (NB / normal)
models.M: Gradient boosting mean + NB / normal distribution (ML challenger)

status_note: Model v0.4.2: v0.4.1 with backups' designed-run shares trimmed (to 70%) in past games a bigger-role teammate who is back this week missed, so a back's share while the starter was out no longer carries over in full (D-031). Stacking weights frozen on 2022-2023 validation. Probabilities are conditional on the player taking part (most bookmakers void a player prop if he does not play). No bookmaker prices were available to this edition, so no value claims are made.
